texts.title: Virtual Accounts
texts.tagline:
Accept fiat and crypto.
Know exactly who got paid.
texts.description: Every seller gets their own account that takes pesos, dollars, or crypto. Deposits tag themselves automatically. You never sort a transaction again.
texts.who: Marketplaces, platforms, and wallets handling money for multiple sellers who want both fiat and crypto inflows, with every deposit attributed automatically.

what: Accept both fiat and crypto: PHP via InstaPay and PESONet, major crypto and chains.
Unique receiving account for every seller. One-time or multi-use.
Auto-credit to your master account with a real-time webhook on every deposit.

pricing.text: Set per partner, by transaction and currency.
